card.text: Young giant planet about 150 au from the ROXs 42B pair, only a few million years old.

introduction.text: ROXs 42B b is a young giant planet about 150 au from a close pair of stars in Ophiuchus. Its spectrum shows a carbon-to-oxygen ratio like its stars'.

sources.label: Inglis et al. 2024
sources.quote: agree with that of its host stars within 1
